doc:
Memory — human root account and hierarchical permissioned sub-agent layer.

 One slim [`MemoryAccount`] per human owner (linked from [`social_contracts::profile::Profile`]).
 Each sub-agent is a **shared derived object** keyed by `(memory_account_id, derived_address)`.
 Agents sign as `derived_address` and resolve to the human `principal_owner` for profile,
 platform join, and MyData.

 **Hierarchy:** `parent_object_id` points up; no child list on parent. Max depth 8.
 **Registry:** auth mirror [`Table`] on [`MemoryAccount`] keyed by `derived_address` (plus
 object-id reverse index) so social/MyData PTBs need only [`MemoryAccount`], not ancestor refs.
 **Lifecycle:** deactivate/revoke operate on explicit agent objects; subtree batches are
 computed off-chain (indexer/server).

 **`max_action_spend`:** optional per-transaction MYSO (MIST) ceiling for sub-agent signers.

 ## Indexer event payloads

 **SubAgentRegistered / SubAgentUpdated:** `account_id`, `principal_owner`, `profile_id`,
 `agent_object_id`, `derived_address`, `label`, `identity_class`, `role_tags`, `capabilities`,
 `delegatable_caps`, `register_scope`, `approval_required_caps`, `max_action_spend`, `platform_scope`,
 `parent_object_id`, `depth`, `registered_by`, `expires_at`, `active`, `created_at`

 **SubAgentDeactivated / SubAgentRevoked:** identifiers above + `agent_object_id`, `derived_address`

 **SubAgentsClearedOnTransfer:** `account_id`, `principal_owner`, `profile_id`,
 `previous_owner`, `new_owner`, `revoked_count`

 **Social events** (post module): all include `actor_address`, `sub_agent_id` (agent object id),
 `action_identity_class` and reactions add `principal_owner`.

create_memory_admin_cap.doc: Create a [`MemoryAdminCap`] for bootstrap (package visibility only).

transfer_account_owner_with_profile.doc:
Profile transfer must revoke all sub-agent objects in the same PTB (via [`revoke_sub_agent`])
 before calling [`profile::transfer_profile_with_memory`].

create_agentic_organization.doc: Human owner creates a competitive agentic organization (max 8 per account).

ensure_org_memory_group.doc:
Lazy-create the org's memory share group (a `PermissionedGroup<MemorySharePackage>`
 derived from the org UID). Owner-only; idempotent. The owner receives
 `PermissionsAdmin` + `ExtensionPermissionsAdmin` from group creation, then typically
 grants `ExtensionPermissionsAdmin` to the org root agent's derived address once so the
 root agent can manage member permissions without further human transactions.

org_memory_group_address.doc: Deterministic address of the org's memory share group (whether or not created yet).

org_memory_group_exists.doc: Whether the org's memory share group has been created.

assert_org_permission.doc:
Shared authorization helper for org-scoped permissions. Verifies the group is the
 org's derived share group, the org is active, and `addr` holds witness permission `P`.
 Used by this module and `ai_credit` (role-gated budget/approval entries) so permission
 checks are never duplicated per call site.

grant_org_memory_permission.doc:
Grant org permissions (mask over the fixed witness set) to a member.
 Caller must hold `ExtensionPermissionsAdmin` on the group (owner from creation, or a
 delegated manager such as the org root agent). Granting is idempotent per bit.

revoke_org_memory_permission.doc: Revoke org permissions (mask) from a member. Revocation is idempotent per bit.

define_custom_org_role.doc:
Define (or redefine) a custom org role as a named mask. Built-in role names are
 reserved. Redefinition is safe: assignments record their exact granted delta.

assign_org_role.doc:
Assign a role (built-in or custom) to a member: grants the role's constituent
 witnesses and records the exact granted delta for later revocation.

revoke_org_role.doc:
Revoke a role assignment: removes exactly the delta the assignment granted
 (permissions the member held before the assignment are untouched).

org_role_assignment_mask.doc: Assigned-delta mask for a role assignment, if present.

create_org_invitation.doc:
Create a pending invitation for `invitee`. At least one of `role_name` or
 `permissions_mask` must be set. The invitee accepts or declines via the
 corresponding entry functions.

accept_org_invitation.doc:
Accept a pending invitation: grants the invited role and/or permissions,
 then removes the invitation dynamic field.

decline_org_invitation.doc: Decline a pending invitation and remove the invitation dynamic field.

org_role_mask.doc: Effective mask for a role name (built-in constant or custom definition).

approve_org_key_policy.doc:
Approve MYDATA key release for org-shared memory: the account owner (own-blob suffix)
 or any holder of `OrgMemoryReader` on the org's share group. Registered sub-agents
 must additionally have an active ancestor chain.

register_sub_agent.doc: Human owner registers a root-level sub-agent bound to an organization.

register_sub_agent_delegated.doc: Delegated agent registers a child or peer sub-agent.

emit_sub_agents_cleared_on_transfer.doc: Emit bulk-clear audit after the last agent revoke during profile transfer orchestration.

ensure_agent_memory_vault.doc: Lazy-create per-agent memory vault derived from the sub-agent object.

assert_action_spend_limit.doc: Per-transaction MYSO (MIST) spend ceiling for sub-agents. Principal owner is exempt.

is_descendant_agent.doc:
True when `descendant_id` sits strictly below `ancestor_id` in the agent tree
 (walks the registry mirror; bounded by MAX_AGENT_DEPTH). Self is not a descendant.

assert_org_permission_manager.doc:
The framework re-checks manager permission per grant/revoke; this explicit check exists
 so wrappers fail fast (and so no-op masks cannot bypass authorization entirely).

assert_member_grantable.doc:
Grantable members: human addresses (org staff, not in the agents table) or registered
 sub-agents belonging to this org. Cross-org agent grants are rejected because the
 relayer scopes org recall by the agent's own organization.

grant_org_permissions_from_mask_via_org.doc:
Grant each witness in `mask` via the org object's delegate admin on the group.
 Used when the transaction sender is the invitee (accept path) rather than a manager.

ensure_org_group_delegate_admin.doc:
One-time bootstrap: grant the org shared object delegate admin on its memory group so
 invitation accept can fulfill grants without the invitee holding manager permission.

grant_org_permissions_from_mask.doc:
Grant each witness in `mask` the member does not already hold. Returns the delta
 actually granted. Static per-bit branches (Move cannot grant by runtime TypeName).

revoke_org_permissions_from_mask.doc: Revoke each witness in `mask` the member currently holds. Returns the delta revoked.

MemorySharePackage.doc: Package witness for `PermissionedGroup<MemorySharePackage>` (org memory share groups).

OrgMemoryGroupTag.doc: Derivation key for the per-organization memory share group (derived from the org UID).

OrgMemoryReader.doc: Permission to read org-visible shared memory (relayer recall scope + MYDATA key release).

OrgMemoryWriter.doc: Permission to write org-visible shared memory.

OrgAgentManager.doc: Permission to manage the org's agent fleet (dashboard + future scheduler surfaces).

OrgBudgetManager.doc: Permission to manage AI-credit budgets for the org's agents (`ai_credit::set_agent_budget_as_manager`).

OrgSpendApprover.doc: Permission to approve over-threshold AI-credit spends (`ai_credit::approve_agent_spend_as_approver`).

OrgDashboardViewer.doc: Permission to view org dashboards (recorded on-chain; server-side read gating is a later phase).

OrgAuditor.doc: Permission to read org audit logs (recorded on-chain; server-side read gating is a later phase).

OrgGovernanceProposer.doc: Permission to create governance proposals for the organization.

OrgGovernanceVoter.doc: Permission to vote on governance proposals for the organization.

OrgInvitationKey.doc: Dynamic-field key on the org UID for a pending invitation to `invitee`.

OrgInvitation.doc: Pending org membership invitation stored on the org UID.

OrgCustomRoleKey.doc: Dynamic-field key on the org UID for a custom role definition (`name -> mask`).

OrgRoleAssignmentKey.doc:
Dynamic-field key on the org UID recording a role assignment's exact granted delta,
 so revocation removes precisely what the assignment added (immune to role redefinition
 and to overlap with direct grants or other roles).

AgenticOrganization.doc: Competitive agentic organization wrapper (one root-agent tree per org).

AgentRegistryEntry.doc: Auth mirror for on-chain ancestor walks without PTB ancestor inputs.

SubAgent.doc: Shared derived sub-agent object (one per agent).

AgentMemoryVault.doc: Lazy per-agent memory blob anchor (derived from [`SubAgent`]).

MemoryAccount.doc: Human root plus on-chain agent auth index (shared [`SubAgent`] objects remain canonical).

mask.doc: Full mask of the role at assignment time.

granted_mask.doc: Delta actually granted (excludes permissions the member already held).

revoked_mask.doc: Delta actually revoked (the assignment's recorded granted_mask).
